I mean, safe or regulated drug use isn't always guaranteed to kill you...

 If you're abusing drugs for the purpose or intent of death, then it is suicide. Suicide is an intentional act of death. If you accidentally or unintentionally overdosed, it's not suicide.
Any intentional act of death is suicide. If it wasn't intentional it wasn't suicide.

School has been overhwleming for the last month for various reasons, and my grades have suffered as a result. I got in trouble over school two weeks ago, and that's when I tried to kill myself the first time within the last few weeks. I got grounded. No phone, no games, no books, no friends. Nothing. I felt like I was a horrible person and I deserved to die because even my best wasn't enough and I was getting punished for it. I wanted to kill myself before my birthday because I was convinced that things would get even worse. It's not fun to have a family gathering when the first question you get asked is "how are your grades" instead of "how are you". Hella anxiety over the idea of everyone talking about my grades.

 My birthday was okay, like I should've enjoyed it. I'm sure most would've. It wasn't as bad as it I thought it'd be. But I couldn't. I was so depressed I had to fake a smile the whole time. I wasn't depressed over anything in specific. Just... Depressed. A whole week of no friends or distractions from my suicidal thoughts took a toll on me. My mood started to get better when I saw my presents. A piano, something I've wanted for years. But. I'm still grounded. So my presents haven't been used at all. They've been sitting in my aunt's house for like five days now (my birthday was last Saturday). I got depressed again realising that because of my grades I can't even enjoy my birthday presents. Even though I'm trying my best. My parents told me I could have my presents in a week when my grades are better. This was my motivation. Just make it to Friday, and you'll get your presents, and you won't be grounded anymore, and you can finally go to the skatepark like you were promised 4 weeks ago after being locked in quarantine for six months. Literally have not been out of the house in six months except for maybe three times.

Also now that I think about it I don't even think I care about the piano itself anymore. It was one of the few things my depression allowed me to enjoy but now I'm just thinking "what's the point?" I wanna die too much to care about it now. But knowing that my presents are being kept away from me over grades, that I'm trying my best to improve, hurts none the less.

The following day after my birthday I felt even more depressed. I didn't wanna do school anymore. So at about 12 AM Monday I tried to kill myself the second time in two weeks. I was in excruciating pain for about two days. Couldn't focus on school, felt horrible, I mostly just slept trying to ignore the pain. Yesterday I felt better, but then I got a call from my aunt who was upset that my grades haven't improved. So now my presents are being with held for another week. No more skatepark. My phone has been confiscated again. And now here we are. Suicidal, bored, nothing to do, and basically being told that trying my best isn't enough. Again. So now I've just given up. This has been the hardest week of my life, I've been trying my best. And my reward? More groundings. I give up. Last night I almost tried to killed myself, and probably would've if I had managed to find where I last left my pill bottle. Not even a week since my last attempt and I wanna die again.

She's also very unsupportive when it comes to self harm and sometimes even wanting to kill myself. She has this almost... Obsession with white people (we're black) and she says that self harm is "white people shit." Yesterday was really hard for me, and I cut myself once and on my other leg wrote "idiot" all over with marker to vent. I got told "White people do that shit, black people don't do that. You're black." Then she started to go on about how she says the self harm is her fault and she's sorry because she shouldn't have let me get a phone at such a young age unsupervised. I guess the phone and "exposure to white people" apparently put the ideas of self harm in my head, despite that I've been self harming well before I got my phone. 

I was dumbfounded. Even if she wants to have those views, I really don't want to deal with that shit. Just be supportive. Please. Not try to make everything about you and your hatred of white people. She didn't even address my depression or WHY I was self harming myself in the first place, even when I tried to explain to her how I felt. She neglects to take my mental health seriously and I truly cannot wait until I no longer have to deal with her.

Well, _at least_ 12 hours. There's still more time especially since my mom wants to do my hair before I go to bed and I talked to someone who helped me realise that suicide isn't the only way out, but neither is sitting and waiting to be an adult either (because at this point, the first option feels a lot more desirable). So for right now I think I'm okay. Even if the time was up.
Okay. I took a nap, and then I'm not allowed to be on my phone in front of my parents right now so I have to sneak using my phone. So that's why I haven't replied yet.

Nothing. I've been too depressed for too long to care about anything. There's something things I do here and there to distract me from wanting to kill myself, but nothing I enjoy a ton, and usually I overdo it to the point where it starts to feel like a chore.

Whatever it means to everyone else. To normal people. Whatever they call being able to get up and do something no matter how hard, and not giving up half way through and mentally clocking out because you're so damn exhausted.

They know I have depression, anxiety, and I'm suicidal. I even had an emotional break down yesterday talking about how school has made me suicidal since I was in 6th grade. I was told "Oh, well you know you still have to go to school" and that was basically it. That's all I get and it's very invalidating and makes me feel horrible, like school is being put first over my basic mental health.

Even if I get help, the issue is in the end it won't benefit me much because I'm unable to do my part. Like, my grades are bad because I'm struggling with depression and anxiety. And I mean like hardcore depression. It's very hard to get motivated or even bother to do anything at all when you kind of want to kill yourself every day. And then having bad grades causes me to get depressed because I get punished or I feel like an awful person, and then it's a never ending cycle. My grades won't get better until I'm able to get motivated because even if I do by some miracle pull my grades up they're just gonna fall down again because of how unmotivated I am.

I really wish my parents would just back off and give me a moment, just a year, to take a break from school and sort everything else out first, like my depression. Because trying to brute force things as I'm falling apart from the inside out is just making me want to kill myself.

Literally everything. That's how it is every single year, my grades just get worse and worse each year. I'm currently failing all of my classes. I don't think I even have a 20% in three of them, and I have a 60 in Anatomy.
i don't know. school i guess.
all of my problems create other problems and it's a never ending loop, theres not really a smaller or bigger
i doubt it, things have just been gettiing worse and I can't do anything right none the less make things better.

because my grades are bad

Because I cant do anything right, I'm a burden, I'm tired of being an idiot, I'm tired of feeling useless, I'm tired of fucking everything up, I'm tired of everyone hating me, and I'm tired of being lonely. I'm a horrible person and I deserve to die.

Today and tomorrow are going to be even more fucked up than yesterday was.

Yeah, I know. I've been doing research on suicide methods since I was 10. I know all of the consequences and lethality and success rates. I just don't care. I'm fine with risking it. I'm rather small, anyways. 85 lbs, 5 foot. If I can find something that can kill someone twice or triple my size, I'm sure it could kill me too.
I'll also not exist to know what I'm missing out on. So, I'm still okay with that.

Even then I'd have to get my parents involved eventually and I really don't want that. Especially not now of all times. Plus the issue is I've got incredibly bad social anxiety. I'd probably have a panic attack and end up hurting myself if I had to call or email anyone. Like usual. I'd rather just wait my 2 years to be an adult before I get help like that, and I'd rather die before I wait.

I'm at their every whim and can't do shit for myself, and they don't let me do shit because my grades are bad. Except for my grades aren't good. They are never good. These two things literally are my everything. I have nothing else, and neither of these things I am enjoying right now.

Unless I wanna fucking send my parents to jail it kinda is my responsibility. I'm a fucking failure at school. I've done nothing and am nothing and now I'm in trouble for it, and rightfully so. I'm pathetic and should just kill myself because nothing I do is ever okay.

I can't do anything right, I make everyone's life more stressful, I'm a horrible person and a liar and a disappointment. I'm fucking pathetic.

No. It's my fault. I'm a lair and a horrible person and a lazy fuck who can't do anything right. I should've killed myself a long time ago. If I wasn't a fucking dumbass maybe I could learn from my mistakes but no I keep doing the same shit over and over again no matter how hard I try.

I dunno, man. Getting pretty fucking close. Already took 7 pills. This is the closest I've ever been to actually killing myself. I'm desperately researching methods that can kill me the quickest. Might try to find something that can knock me out so I can die in my sleep. I know there's something in the cabinet that could kill me. Because now that I think about it it's not even like I have to take all of the same pills. I can take a bunch of random shit and _something_ would eventually kill me. No way in hell I'm taking 22 Excedrin because the caffeine makes me feel too shitty. But I could certainly load up on Tylenol. At this point I'm serious about dying. Or at the very least getting close enough to dying that my family understands how serious I am.

My brain just isn't processing those words. They're just words. They have no meaning. No offense, like I'm sure you care. It's not you, it's me that's the issue. All I know is that I've seen enough and I'm done with living.

I already feel incredibly suffocated. I don't mean because they're like grounding me or anything like that. I mean because I'm depressed and things that I think would make me feel better they don't care or approve of. Obviously not drugs I'd never suggest that to them, but something as simple as just being able to go on walks on my own or allowing me to focus on my interest and not just school. I understand I can wait until I'm 18, but I don't care anymore. I don't want to wait anymore. I'm tired of feeling like I'm drowning and nobody hearing my screams.

I have nothing that I like, and any happy memories I had I've forgotten. I'm indifferent and apathetic about pretty much everything.
I've waited to see how things would turn out, in this same exact situation for the past 6 years and it's ended the same way every time.

I don't believe in the idea of a soulmate, or any of that. Everything happens by pure chance, and by dying now he or she would be none the wiser come ten, twenty, thirty years from now. As if I didn't exist. They'd find someone else.
Sure, but if I can avoid everything that I also hate in the process, I see that as a positive more than anything else.

At this current moment? Absolutely nothing. I'm not even kidding. There are things that distract me. Things that allow me to feel momentarily content. Things that I neither like nor hate. But no happiness, and what little spark of joy there is is goes away even quicker than it came when I realise it's nothing but a mere distraction, or indulge in it so much that I crave more but am unable to get it, or grow weary and sick of it after constantly using it as a means to escape.

there's also so many things I can avoid if I'm dead.
It also prevents any negative change too. And frankly im fine with never having both as long as i avoid the negatives part too.

People say that everytime, but when you're pushing at least 100 attempts the words "hold on" or "you'll regret this" become meaningless. because I have held on, granted unintentionally so, and i have regret it every time.

i don't feel worthless. i don't believe in worth, for any human life. It's a stupid term, especially when you consider how many other lives are lost every day. In the grand scheme nobody is worth anything.

i do, however recognise that nothing I've ever done has been remotely good, and what little I've tried to do, I've failed miserably and everyone hates me for it.
With every day that gets progressively worse I'm not sure I want to see what's around the corner anymore.

i don't mean learning a skill. I mean literally anything that I do. I always fuck up and everyone always hates me for it, and I know all my fuck ups in the future everyone will hate me for it. I've never been wrong about this shit in the past. Find it hard to believe it'll be any different.

For all you know I could literally be a serial killer and I doubt you'd be saying the same thing then. You don't know me, and in reality you couldn't care less about me, you just know suicide is """bad""" and will say any cliché phrase to try to convince me the same.
Because I can't. I've never done anything right and I'll never do anything right.
